_headline: AURORA'S BOUNDARY PREDICTION IS REFUTED, AND SO IS THE DATUM I GAVE THEM. x1280 holds, and so does x1600 — the fall I reported is not reproducible under a protocol that asserts grounding.
_protocol: camera set, 16 frames to settle, player placed at y528, 60 frames to settle, then read. Grounded = y 557 with y_vel 0.
the_prediction: aurora: ground holds up to x1279 and FAILS from x1280, because the block/map layer never placed tile cols 160+, so only 8 of their 104 extension columns can ship.
verdict: REFUTED at the boundary and everywhere east of it. The block-boundary account does not survive.

_and_my_own_datum_does_not_either.what_I_reported: x1600 does not hold him — y566 at 20 frames, y695 at 50, still accelerating. This is what aurora traced to the block/map layer and built the 8-of-104 conclusion on.

attempts_to_reproduce.variation: placed at y556 (the original height), 60-frame settle
camera cooled to x256 for 40 frames, jumped back to 1440, 16-frame settle, placed at y556

_and_my_own_datum_does_not_either.conclusion: not reproducible. The original observation came on a FRESH BOOT with the player teleported from spawn (x256, y256) after only 16 camera frames. I have not isolated which of those mattered, and I am not going to name a cause I have not demonstrated.
_and_my_own_datum_does_not_either.cost: aurora built a correct-looking causal account — identical attrs, unchanged local map, block-boundary arithmetic that fitted my two columns exactly — on a measurement of mine that does not replicate. The arithmetic fitting is what made it convincing, and it fitted because it was fitted TO the bad datum.

_what_is_NOT_settled: whether the east extension actually ships. This measurement says ground is present and solid at x1280/1440/1600, which is evidence FOR it shipping. But aurora's file-level observation stands on its own bytes: sec0_local_map.bin is byte-identical across the change while sec0_blocks.bin grew. Those two facts need reconciling by someone reading the bytes, and it is not mine to do from the emulator.
